description:
The process starts when a company schedules a compliance audit for regulations such as ISO standards, safety protocols, or environmental guidelines.
Internal teams prepare documentation, gather evidence, and conduct a self-assessment before the external audit.
Auditors review the company's processes and identify any gaps or issues.
After making the necessary corrections or improvements, the company undergoes a final audit.
If all criteria are met, the company is awarded certification, and the process concludes with the issuance of official documents.

  <bpmn:process id="Process_ComplianceAudit" name="Compliance Audit Process" isExecutable="false">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AwardCertification</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueOfficialDocuments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotCertified</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Auditors" name="External Auditors">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ConductExternalAudit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewFindings</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AuditProcess" name="Audit process started"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ScheduleAudit" name="Schedule compliance audit"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Split" name="Start internal preparation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDocumentation" name="Prepare documentation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherEvidence" name="Gather evidence"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelfAssessment" name="Conduct self-assessment"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Prep_Join" name="Internal preparation complete"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductExternalAudit" name="Conduct external audit of company processes"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewFindings" name="Review processes and identify gaps or issues"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeCorrections" name="Make necessary corrections or improvements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FinalAudit" name="Undergo final audit"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CriteriaMet_Split" name="All criteria met?" default="Flow_CriteriaNotMet"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AwardCertification" name="Award certification"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" name="Issue official documents"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotCertified" name="Certification not awarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Schedule" sourceRef="Start_AuditProcess" targetRef="Task_ScheduleAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Schedule_PrepSplit" sourceRef="Task_ScheduleAudit" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_Prepare" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_Gather" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_GatherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepSplit_SelfAssess" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Split" targetRef="Task_SelfAssessment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prepare_PrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDocumentation" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_PrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_GatherEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfAssess_PrepJoin" sourceRef="Task_SelfAssessment" targetRef="Gateway_Prep_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepJoin_ExtAudit" sourceRef="Gateway_Prep_Join" targetRef="Task_ConductExternalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtAudit_Review" sourceRef="Task_ConductExternalAudit" targetRef="Task_ReviewFindings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Review_Corrections" sourceRef="Task_ReviewFindings" targetRef="Task_MakeCorrections"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Corrections_FinalAudit" sourceRef="Task_MakeCorrections" targetRef="Task_FinalAudit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FinalAudit_CriteriaSplit" sourceRef="Task_FinalAudit" targetRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CriteriaMet" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CriteriaMet_Split" targetRef="Task_AwardCertification">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${allCriteriaMet}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Award_Issue" sourceRef="Task_AwardCertification" targetRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Issue_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueOfficialDocuments" targetRef="End_Certified"/>
  </bpmn:process>
